content:
The v4.22.0 release of Lean is here!

The Lean v4.22.0 release brings multiple new features and bug fixes, including grind and the new compiler

Please read the release notes for details.

Mathlib, Batteries, Verso, the reference manual, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and repl are now available for v4.22.0:

  • there is a v4.22.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.
Let's use the existing #general > v4.22.0-rc2 for discussion of the v4.22.0 release.
